reading: App charges billed through Shopify: added to the merchant's Shopify invoice, collected by Shopify, which pays out the developer's share and handles chargebacks (SH-S-0281, SH-S-0269, SH-S-0282, SH-S-0283), with Shopify's Billing API and the admin's charge approval routes (SH-S-0769, SH-S-5065). M-010 holds Shopify's partner payouts (SH-C-169) too; that concern is area PTN's, for a later batch (notes). Its webhook topics on the app's subscription are cited in CM-APP-004, under the same parent.

Apps and third-party services: the admin's Apps section, its routes and staff permissions, and the plan line Integrate with 1000s of apps (SH-S-1495, SH-S-5028, SH-S-7052). M-067 is a difference of grain: Shopify splits apps in general from the App Store (SH-C-157, CM-APP-002); this concern is the coarser one. Its app/uninstalled topic is cited in CM-APP-004, its embedded apps' parent route in CM-APP-007 and its extension details route in CM-APP-006, all under this capability.

The Shopify App Store, its review and its distribution (SH-S-2753, SH-S-0698, SH-S-2852). Its rule that listed apps use Shopify's billing (SH-S-0284) is cited in CM-APP-003, and custom distribution (SH-S-0693) in CM-APP-009, both under the same parent CM-APP-001.
Shopify Functions as such: developers customize Shopify's backend logic, and Shopify invokes the functions within the customer journey (SH-S-0681, SH-S-0683).

Joined on role with SA-C-197, a reading: both are how an app shows its own UI inside the admin. SH-C-164 holds two forms, App Home (SH-S-2182) and admin UI extensions on core admin pages (SH-S-0711), each a capability under this one (CM-APP-007, CM-APP-008); being coarser than either, it lands in their parent. No statement of either side defines the other's term.

Custom apps developed in the admin: App development in the Apps section, its staff permissions and the plan line Build custom apps using Shopify APIs (SH-S-7143, SH-S-5038, SH-S-7054). Salla's statements hold none found, so it is single.

The App Store's terms policy for developers (SA-S-5082, SA-S-0015), under which Salla's team reviews, accepts or rejects any app submitted (SA-S-0023). It is a part of the App Store, with no capability finer than CM-APP-002 to hold it. Its article on payment through Salla (SA-S-0025, a statement of SA-C-194 and SA-C-195) is cited in CM-APP-003.

App Events: Salla's app.installed, app.uninstalled, trial, subscription, authorization, settings and feedback events (SA-S-5093, SA-S-1649 to SA-S-1656), joined on the same identifiers: Salla's app.uninstalled and Shopify's app/uninstalled, and the app's subscription events (app.subscription.started; app_subscriptions/update). Not by M-071: that match joins SA-C-193 to the Partner Program (SH-C-168) because Shopify keeps its App Events API in it, a difference of grain; SH-C-168 is area PTN's, for a later batch, and its App Events API is cited here (SH-I-0075, SH-I-0171), so the landing doesn't depend on where SH-C-168 lands (notes).

App Store and installed apps: the dashboard app at /apps with My apps and Installed apps, and the permission marketplace_apps_management, named التطبيقات المثبتة (SA-S-3541, SA-S-1883, SA-S-1702, SA-S-2629). It holds both the App Store and the store's installed apps, so it is coarser than CM-APP-002 and lands in its parent; its App Store link and app categories are cited in CM-APP-002.

A paid app's payment goes through Salla, which keeps a share, with App Subscriptions and the App API's Subscriptions folder (SA-S-0025, SA-S-0026, SA-S-1927, SA-S-1077). What doesn't fit: the concern also holds the partner's finances, Payouts, Billings, Operation records and the Billing System Salla partners with its monthly invoices for apps (SA-S-1936, SA-S-1937, SA-S-1938, SA-S-1174, SA-S-0046, SA-S-0045), payout timing and reports (SA-S-0027, SA-S-0034) and the payout statuses; Shopify keeps those apart in SH-C-169 (M-010), area PTN, which a later batch of this part takes. They are not cited here, for that batch to cite (notes).
App Functions: serverless functions that run when events occur in a store, fully managed by Salla (SA-S-0187, SA-S-0190), with their event folders (SA-S-1078, SA-S-1079).

Joined on role with Shopify's App Home, a reading: both are an app's own page shown inside the admin, Salla's third-party application in an iframe in the Merchant Dashboard (SA-S-0197), Shopify's App Home with its iframe API (SH-S-2182, SH-I-0054). The SDK's modules, cited in the parent CM-APP-006, serve that page.
